method: Symptom-directed ordering: per-task family ranking from the failing-test symptom (actual vs expected, boundary input, boolean assertion, None return) under the same efficient 2-calls/try, cap-27 model as v2. Fixing sets reused from the v2 results file (order-independent, fixed-harness measured); order-P ranks reproduced exactly as verification.
rules: R0 actual None -> recon first; R1 bool assertion -> boolean first; R2 boundary input -> comparator first; R3 |delta|==1 or rel<=5% -> off_by_one/wrong_constant first; R4 other numeric -> swapped_operands first; R5 default -> prompt order P.
